items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I had gotten an inquiry from Kenny Drew in Copenhagen but — through Red Mitchell about me coming there to play with him and Neils-Pederson.

ctx.x: No he did not. He befriended a fella named Milt Fillius who did go to college here, class of ’44, and Milt Fillius was a tremendous jazz fan and supporter, almost like a patron. He got to know Joe and so around 1993 they decided that too many musicians were passing away without getting their stories told. And so we started this project and Joe lent his reputation to it. He did some interviewing for us and he received an honorary degree from Hamilton College and — © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

Another beautiful person. I got to work with him for a few weeks in the ‘60s and he wanted a trio with Jim Hughart and Mike Melvoin and I and we went up to Seattle and played and did some radio up there which was later released as half of an LP. But anyway Joe loved the trio and we loved him. He was so great once we settled in together after a few nights man I just felt like going home every night. And he was so great that he — I would see him after that and he would always tell people that he really loved my…
